name: VirtualDJ Stems Import
author: ThomasDalgas
summary: Read-only automatic USB scan for VirtualDJ stem exports with on-deck status.
description: Automatically scans mounted USB Contents folders for VirtualDJ stem exports in a background worker. Shows complete and incomplete file sets, scan errors, an automatic-scan toggle and Scan again. USB removal or remount cancels stale results. Completeness is a file inventory, not playback readiness. Does not convert, rename, delete or write audio/library files. Only the on/off preference is saved through the core settings API.
